slides.title: Coming soon: Context engineering
slides.summary: Choosing what goes into the model's context window at every step. This chapter is on its way.
body: An agent's context window is its whole working memory. Context engineering is choosing what goes in it, and what stays out, at every step.

ul: Why more context isn't always better (context rot)
Fetching what's needed, just in time
Sub-agents that start with a clean context
Notes and memory files that outlive the window
